About 2 km from Kelambakkam on Chennai Mamallapuram road.A village called Taiyur situated in the western direction once had 7 temples.At present only 3 temples are under worship.Other temples are said to be ruined in the forest. Sri Mariswarar Temple Moolav Sri Mariswarar Ambal Sri Aramvalarthanayaki. flagpoleAlong with Nandi Mandapam and Raja Gopuram, this temple has Pancha Goshta Murthys, Vinayagar, Murugan, Chandikeswarar, Surya, Bhairava and Hanuman Navakrigam.A puja is held every day.Thirukkulam is found in a dry state.Contact Mr. Ramamurthy- 7299552933, Mr. Kannan-9790825558, Mr. Rajesh-9941745535.Bus Tambaram-Thaiyur (55 Sri Murugeeswarar Temple Moolavar Sri Murugeswar (Swayambu) Ambal Sri Marakatambikai It is history that Lord Muruga worshiped the Lord.Because of that, he is known as Murugeeswarar.Lord Muruga has also arisen here as Swayambu.There are sanctuaries of flag tree, Pancha Goshtas, Ganesha, Surya, Bhairava and Navagraha.It is considered as a place to remedy all planetary doshas.A period of worship.Contact Mr. Ramamurthy- 7299552933, Mr. Kannan-9790825558, Mr. Rajesh-9941745535.Bus Tambaram-Thaiyur (55 Sri Alageeswar Temple Moolav Sri Alageeswarar Ambal Sri Alagambikai. The old temple is currently being renovated.Dwara Ganapati, Murugan, Pancha Goshta Shrines Perumal, and Navagragam.Thirukulam in front of the temple.A period puja.Contact Mr. Ramamurthy- 7299552933, Mr. Kannan-9790825558, Mr. Rajesh-9941745535.Bus Tambaram-Thaiyur (55k)k)k)

This temple is on the side of the road next to Kelambakkam on Chennai Mamallapuram road.As Shri Mahavishnu worshiped, the Lord appears here with the name of Shri Senkanmaleeswarar.On the square pedestal, Swami faces east and Ambal Sri Brahannayake faces south.The temple is flanked by the flag tree Nandi Mandapam prakaram and has shrines of Goshta Murthy, Ganesha, Murugan, Gajalakshmi, Bhairava, Surya, Jeshta Devi and Navagraha shrines.Lord Tirumeni is composed of Salagram.It is a place of relief for all diseases related to eyes.If you crawl and worship the Lord wholeheartedly, you will get benefit.Contact Mr Ganesa Gurus- 9952924944, Thiruvenkatesan- 9176770308, Mr Kamalakannan- 9884504932.

Sri Mekambikai Sametha Sri Meghnatheeswarar Temple is located at Melakottaiyur Village on Vandalur Kelambakkam Road.This 1400 year old temple has been renovated and is well maintained.The temple includes Koshta Murthas, Kannimoolai Ganapati, Valli Devasena Murugan, Sandikeswarar, Bhairava, Navagragam shrines.Flagpole, Altar, Nandi Mandapam in front of temple.Moolavar Sri Meghnatheeswarar gives darshan on the square peeda towards the west.Swami could not be taken out during renovation work.Even today we can see that Shiva Lingam is seen leaning slightly to the right or left during Mahapradosha.Thala Purana says that Varunadeva, who was cursed by Sage Sri Durvasa, established a tirtha here and worshiped Isaan and got rid of the curse.The tirtha here is Varuna tirtha Eason is the bestower of reparation People worship Isaan here for marriage prevention, child birth, physical health, promotion, debt relief.Many people come to this temple and worship the Lord.108 sangabhishekams are performed here on every Pradosha day. Contact Mr. Siva Gurus-9962267286, Mr. Bhaktavachalam- 9941416205, Mr. Mahendran-7358491381.

By road, Kelambakkam is 2 km.This temple is located in Badur which comes before.The very old temple is now giving a new look.Sri Manikandeswarar is the source of the temple with the flagpole.Ambal Shri Marakadavalli.The temple with Pancha Shiva Koshta has shrines of Vinayaka, Murugan, Ayyappan, Navagragam, Bhairava and Surya.An old Shiva Lingam is seen to the left of the temple entrance.Puja is held for two periods. The main plant is the banyan tree.The temple pond is at the back.Kosala is also maintained here. To the left of the temple is the Srinivasa Perumal shrine.Sri Lakshmi's mother on Perumal's forehead is something that cannot be seen anywhere else.Besides Prayoga Chakram other shrines are Lakshmi Taiar, Garuda, Andal, Anjaneyar.Contact Mr. Ananda Gurus-9551785164, Mr. Krishnamurthy-7395918536, Mr. Prakash-98403 83097. Omar

Mrs. Bhavani took the Shiva lingam that was looking at the sky on the bank of the pond and built a small temple with the help of others.Swami Thirunamam Sri Saileswarar.Ambal Sri Marakatambikai.Vinayagar, Murugan, Sandikeswarar, Bhairava, Navagragam, Dakshinamurthy, Vishnu Durga etc. were newly consecrated.There is a beautiful pond in front.An old Nandi idol is found on the bank of the pond.For other details Mrs. Bhavani- 9962151046, Mr. Balasubramanian-91761 03629. Near Nawalur, Dalhampur.Buses come here from Tambaram and Adyar. They took the Shivlinga Thirumeni that was outside the cut in the area called Dhalampur Natham and showed them a small temple.The sanctum sanctorum is topped with a shed.Swami Thirunamam Sri Kailasanathar.They are going to keep Ambal from now on.Sometimes a pooja takes place.Tirukulam is at the back.Contact Mr. Balasubramanian-9176103629.

A few years ago, the people of Nawalur built a big temple after taking the Shiva Lingam buried in the earth.This temple was built with the blessings of Kanji Sri Maha Swami.All the deities sannidans are featured here.The name of the Lord is Sri Navaleeswarara.Ambal Thirunamam Sri Akhilandeshwari.Sri Lakshmi Narayana Perumal in a separate temple nearby.All the utsavams are very well done in both the temples.The big pond is in front of the temple.Temple timings are 7-11 am and 5-8 pm.Contact Mr. Ananda Gurus- 9710070515. Navalur, On Omar Road, Choshinganallur is next.All buses stop here.

A Shiva lingam is found on the back wall of a school complex in Karanai village.There are vines all around.There are no visitors here.Some servants in the town are trying to bring the Lord.It is Eason who should show mercy.Contact Mr. Rajesh-9789845302, Mr. Senthilkumar-98843 04592, Mr. Kamalakannan-9962700694, Mr. Karthikeyan- 9940366472. There are buses to Karana from Chennai Saidappettai and Tambaram.

This temple is located in Sirusheri near Kelambakkam, Chennai.Eason, who previously resided in a stone temple with a circular flight structure, now gives darshan in a small shed.Lord facing East on square pedestal.Ambal is nearby.Name unknown.In front of Lord Nadia.Chandikeswarar is outside in worn condition.Perhaps a servant is doing the puja here.Tirukulam is seen opposite. Sri Neela Manikka Perumal presents Sridevi as Boodevi Samethar in the Golam.A separate shrine for Hayagriva.The temple is well maintained.Puja is performed daily.Contact Mr. Sundararajan- 99529 99694, Mr. Sriram-9841046408.There is an auto facility from Nawalur which is on the road to reach this place.And there are buses from Kelambakkam, Adyar.

Built by the Pandya kings, this temple is now resplendent.The source is Sri Devi Bhudevi Sametha Karunakaralakshminarayan.Standing column.Utsavar is the same name.Other shrines here are Twelve Alwars, Vinayaka, Murugan, Panchamuga Anjaneya, Ramanuja, Vishwaksena, Shirdi Baba.One of the 108 Vaishnava thalams, Thiruvidanta Sri Nitya Kalyana Perumal, is visited at Parivettai in Thaimatham and the Thirumanjana Vaipavam takes place.Contact Mr. Ramanathan-9841439552, Mr. Balakrishnan-97912 30348, Mr. Narasimhan-97102 39076. You can reach this village by taking the road to the left after the light post on the Vandalur-Kelambakkam road. There is also ancient Shiva temple in Puducherry village.Lord Thirunam Sri Agastheeswarar.Goddess, Sri Akilandeshwari.Like Pancha Goshta in Shiva Goshta, Ambal also has Pancha Goshta deities.The temple was renovated in 2006 and pujas are being held.Adi Agastheeswarar Shivlingam is found behind the sanctum sanctorum in the prakaram.There are shrines of Vinayagar, Valli Devasena Subramanyar, Bhairava, Chandikeswarar and Navagraha.Puja takes place twice.Contact Mr. Vasudevan-9444118745.Thala Vridsham is a novel.All the celebrations take place here in a grand manner. It also serves as a place of reparation for lost wealth and lost goods.

The temple built by the Brahma sage Shri Satasiva Brahmandral is located in the village of Ilashai.There are numerous deity shrines in this temple, which is located with the Periya Raja Gopuram and the flagpole.In Moolasthan, Sri Pasupadeeswarar is facing east direction.Ambal Sri Simmavalli shrine is facing south.Lord Vishnu is present in a separate temple named Sri Sundara Varadaraja.Sri Kanakavalli's mother also has Tanichannadi.Other shrines are Dwara Ganapati, Murugan, Nataraja, Sivagami, Manikavasar, Pulipani, Kannimoolai Ganapati, Goshta Murthys, Vishwarupa Anjaneya, Surya, Chandran, Bhairava, Pratyangara Devi, Panduranga, Rukmini Devi, Valli Devasena Subramaniar, Sita Rama Lakshmana, Vallalar.Temple time is 9-11 am. Here everyone can go inside the sanctum and worship the Lord.Contact 044 24640306. On the Vandalur-Kelambakkam road, you can reach this temple by taking the road opposite to the Anjaneya temple.

Originally called on Gaja Giri, there is ancient Anjaneya temple on this small hill.On this hill with 108 steps, Anjaneya is a benediction kolam with Thirumeni looking east and facing north without weapon.Puducherry Sri Nithyakalyana Perumal Bari Hunting Ground.A large number of devotees come to this temple which is a great remedy.To fulfill all the prayers, coconuts and bells are worshipped.After the puja here, sprinkling of Valpuri Sangu Theertha on the devotee is considered to be able to remove all doshas.Contact Mr. Suresh Bhatter- 9445299105, Mr. Mohan Bhatter-9444680711, Mr. Satya Narayanan- 9444824722. This hill is located near Vandalur- Kelambakkam road.

About 6 km from Tirupporur, a road leading west leads to Illalur village.The old temple here is now newly built and worship is going on.The name of the Lord is Sri Swayambeeswarar.Ambal Sri Karpakampal is no more.There are shrines of Nandi, Goshta Murthy, Chandikeswarar and Navagraha.The sacred temple is found near Thirukkulam.Earlier Swami was Swayambu at Kulakarai in Vetaveli.Shivratri 6 Kalam, Annabhishekam, Karthikai Deepam, Somavar Pujas are held here.Contact Mr. Chakrapani-9176822119, Mr. Veeraragavan-94450 05635. In the same village there is Sri Amritavalli's mother Samethar Sri Adikesava Perumal Temple. A small temple.Flagpole outside, Garuda Mandapam.In the sanctum sanctorum, Perumal is holding the Pryoga Sakram.Inside there are images of Andal, Wodevar, Nammalvar, Vishwaksenaar, Chakratthalvar and Thiruvathivam.Shree Anjaneya shrine in a separate temple nearby.Contact Mr. Rangaraja Bhattacharya- 8939945775. One time puja is held.A clean temple pond is seen along the steps. Thambaram-Thiruporur, Thambaram-Nellikuppam buses ply here.

The temple was built according to Sri Shankaracharya's Arulasi of Kanchi by taking the Shiva Lingam that was outside the cut.East facing shrine.Tirunam Sri Kamadenu Ishwar.Ambal Sri Gokilampal.There is no Ambal idol.Enthrallment before Swami.A temple pond is found nearby.The temple is situated in Kalavakkam village which is before Thiruporur on Mamallapuram road.Contact Mr. Munusamy-9962596849.

Lord Sri Jalakandeswarar Lord Sri Jagathampal In the temple which is about 2000 years old, Eason has risen as Swayambu.A temple built entirely of stones.There is always moisture in the Lord's womb.Nardhana Vinayagar in Prakaram, Dakshinamurthy, Maha Vishnu, Brahma, Durga in Shiva Koshta with excellent artistic aspect can be seen.Ganesha, who is a maiden, tilts his head and gives a view.Goddesses Lakshmi, Parvati and Saraswati are seen in Ambal Koshta in Prakaram.Thala Vridsham Ilupai.The water in the temple well never runs dry.There is a pond nearby.Sometimes a pooja takes place.Contact Mr. Srinivasan- 9962269957, 9962086925, Mr. Shankar-98405 21944. This village is situated on Chengalpattu Road, Tirupporur.Can also come on Guduvanchery-Kottaimedu road.All Tiruporur-Chengalpattu buses stop here.

As the old temple was completely ruined, the villagers of Acharavaka got together and built a new temple.Moolavar Sri Agastheeswarar.Ambal Shri Anandhavalli.East facing shrine.There are shrines of Dwara Ganapati and Murugan on the facade.The Nandi Mandapam is found in front of the Dwara shrine.There are sanctuaries of Chandikeswarar near Komugam and Navagragam at the north-east corner.Puja takes place for a while.A temple pond is found nearby.Contact Mr. Venkatesan- 9952304174, Mr. Selvakumar-9940216984, Ms. Sasikala-9840804196.Tiruporur is 9 km from here.Come to Sembakkam and visit this temple.Buses come here from Chengalpattu, Velachery, Thiruvanmiyur. There is also ancient Perumal temple in Acharavaka village.Small temple.The Garudalwar shrine is seen outside the temple.In the sanctum sanctorum Sridevi Bhudevi Sametha Sri Karyamanika Perumal stood in the kolam.All seven forms of Alvars are present in the Maha Mandapam.Daily puja takes place.It is said that the Shiva temple here and this temple were built at the same time.

Swami Thirunamam- Sri Malleeswarar Ambal - Sri Manikavalli The stone temple built by the Pallava king Kripadavarman has been a mound of mud since long ago and disappeared in the flood of time.The temple was built in the year 2004 by taking the Shiva Lingam, Chandikeswarar, and Nandi idols that were scattered here and there.With the blessings of Jagathguru Sri Jayendra Saraswati Swami, Mr. Chandrasekaran took great efforts and with the cooperation of the villagers, this work has been completed.There are Pancha Goshta shrines, Dwara Vinayaka, Murugan and Chandikeshwara shrines.Behind the temple there is a Siddhar Samadhi.Pooja is regularly held here for a period of time.Neem is the main plant of the temple.There is also Thirukulam. Madadthur village, about 5 km on the Tiruporur- Chengalpattu road.is far away.Get down by bus at Madadthur Good Road and drive for about 1 km.must goContact Mr Chandrasekaran- 9283736233

The old temple was completely destroyed and only Swami was standing by the pond.The villagers of Thandalam have gathered and built a small temple to worship.There are Ganesha and Murugan idols on both sides of the sanctum sanctorum door.An old Jeshta Devi idol is found under a heat tree nearby.Swami's name is Sri Maheshwaran Ambal Srimaheshwari.Contact Mr. Radhakrishnan - 8754401805, Amsaveni-9790815110.Thiru Eyumalai- 9566267461. 3 KM on Tiruporur- Mamallapuram Road.This village is far away.City buses ply from Tambaram, Tirupporur, and Chennai. Jeshta Devi

On the road from Thiruporur to Mamallapuram, it is about 3 km.If you travel you can find this temple in Alatur village.A very old temple.Flag tree, Rajagopuram, Goshta murthas were once there and now there is nothing.Eason consecrated and worshiped by Mamakarishi Agasthya.So he got the name Sri Agastheeswarar.Ambal Sri Akilandeshwari.Presently Dwara Ganapathi, Valli Devasena, Sametha Murugan, Sandikeswarar, and Bhairava.Opposite is the temple pond.There is a puja for a while.Contact Mr. Kathir Iyer-9444799023, Mr. Dayalan- 8124004808, Mr. Harendran-8680895761.

Sri Ezhilarkuzali Ambal Sametha Sri Eteeswarar Temple, built by Vijayanandi Vikrama Pallavan in AD.Built in the year 773, it was completely destroyed in the floods and there were no pujas for many years, but it was rebuilt in 2011 and Kumbabhishekam was held.Presently two pujas are held.Annotated Nayanar from Thondai country has sung songs in praise of the Lord here.There are some indications that the Siddhas of Adhikatta worshiped Isaan here. In this temple with flagpole and Nandi Mandapam, if you enter the Dwara Balars and enter, Sri Eteeswarar gives darshan to the east.Ambal shrine facing south.Along with the Pancha Goshta shrines there are shrines of Sri Agasthiyar, Sri Vallalar, Sri Bhairava and Sri Surya.A 2000-year-old Shiva lingam found while paving the pond is in a separate shrine. This temple is the best remedy for unsolved cases, marriage ban, child luck.Contact Mr. Murthy- 99415 34893, Mr. Sundararaj-9566184387. On the Chennai-Mamallapuram Omar road lies the village of Baiyanur.From here Mamallapuram is 6 km. Bhayanur Eteeswarar Temple is located on the south bank of Thirukkulam and Karunakara Perumal Temple is on the north bank.Both the temples were built at the same time. Completely stone temple.Sri Karunakara Perumal will present Sri Karunakara Perumal in the golam where Sridevi Bhudevi stood as Samedar, bearing the Prayoga Chakra, if you enter the temple where the flagpole stands with two prakaras.It is said that this Lord was lying in the pond for a long time, and Zameen came to him in a dream and ordered him to be worshiped in the temple. Temple Timings 6 AM-12 PM, 4 PM-7.30 PM.Contact Mr. Kannayadasan-9092270404,

There are two ancient temples overlooking a small hilltop in a very peaceful setting.One is Shiva temple.The other is the Narasimha Perumal Temple.The Esan Thirunam here is Sri Thirumalai Ishwarar.Ambal Sri Sornambikai.Eason gives a majestic view towards the east, surrounded by Goshta idols.A beautiful pond is found at the foot of the hill.Daily puja takes place. Narasimha Temple is on another part of the hill near Shiva Temple.Sri Narasimha Perumal graces the rock as Swami Swayambu.You have to squint to see the very elegant sculptural form.A must visit temple.Pooja takes place here too. It is said by the villagers that when they came to break stones here during the British rule, the crane broke down several times and left here. Ederkunram, 2 km from Kotamedu village on Tiruporur-Sengalpattu road.is far away.Contact Mr. Lokhu- 9095043658, Mr. Parthasarathy-9159129791, Mr. Venkataraman- 7639579700.

The villagers of Vengur have taken the Shiva linga from the clearing and built a small shed to worship it.Swami's name is not known.All the idols from the nearby Perumal temple have disappeared and new idols are being installed.The temple is currently under construction.Nearby is the temple Thirukulam.Contact Mr. Gopalakrishnan-9626576908, Mr. Mohan-93817 74283. You can reach here by buses going to Thiruporur-Sengalpattu, Kanchipuram.

It is history that when Shri Anjaneya was penance to Lord Shiva to get Shivadiksha in the beginning, Isa also willingly gave diksha with Sri Veerabhatra.History says that Anjaneya too was happy and stayed here after doing Shiva Puja. Now there is a small temple on top of the hill.To reach here, take the Singaperumalkoil-Anumanthapuram road and take a small dirt road for 3 km that splits at a village called Darkas to reach the base of the hill.There is no right way to climb a mountain. Anumanthapuram Sri Veerabhatra Temple Shree Veerabhatrar Swamy Temple, a feature of Sivabira, is about 9 kms near Singaperumal Temple.Located far away.This very famous temple is about 3000 years old.After the Dakshan Samharam, Sri Veerapathiraswamy came here very angry and hungry. Mother Kali gave Swami sugarcane yams and mountain honey to satisfy his hunger.As soon as Ambal folded the betel leaf, the hunger subsided and the anger subsided. The source here is Sri Akoravirabhatra.Ambal Sri Kalikampal.Dakshinamurthy and Lingotpavar are the only ones in Koshta.Shree Durga shrine stands alone.There are shrines of Ganesha, Murugan, and Chandikeshwara in the prakaram. place of remedy A place to get relief from evil and witchcraft.Mars also acts as a dosha-reliever.After the evening puja, Shivacharya devotees put Swami Vibhuti on their heads and give prasad to them to remove all evils.Garlanding of betel leaves here is very special.Puja is held here twice.7.00 am to 12.00 pm on new moon and full moon days. For further details Mr. Sentikumar-94442 86077, Mr. Wigneswaran-9976567410, Mr. Duraisamy- 9443616894.

Emperuman Easwaran has a temple in Sirutamur village along with mother Sri Anandhavalli Devi with the name of Bhootagriswarar.Iswaran is presented in white color on a square shaped pedestal.Villagers are building a bigger temple while the old temple is dilapidated.The palalayam is done and the temple is nearing completion.Lord Nandi here has his head turned to the left which is not seen anywhere else.Vinayagar, Valli Devasena Sametha Murugan, Sandikeswarar, Ambal, Patti Lingam and Nandi are ancient deities.Elephant vehicle to Murugan here.Pooja is held regularly.Contact Mr. Jayachandran-9840518826, Mr. Nagarajan- 9382292689, Mr. Vijayan-9444880118. This place is 6 km from Tirupporur.Buses come here from Tiruporur, Chengalpattu, Koyambedu.

Author Sri Vaidyanath (Swayambu) Ambal Sri Taiyalanaiki Other shrines are Goshta Murthys,Nalvar,Vinayak Sekijar,Kashi Vishwanath Visalakshi Murugan,Gaja Lakshmi,Ankarakan,Navagragam. This place is known as Vadavaitheeswaram.History says that Sage Sri Agastya worshiped Isaan and removed the bonds of people.The Sivaganga Theertha here was made by Agathiya.Panguni was happy to see Shivashakti Thirukalyanam here on Uttaram.There is a separate shrine for Ankarakan here. In the nearby village of Vembedu, it is customary to visit Bhairava on the top of the hill and then visit Uthra Vaideeswara Swamy. Mars is the place to get rid of dosha and cure all kinds of ailments. Temple Timings 6 am - 11 pm 4.30 pm - 8.00 pm Contact Mr. Punniakodi-9884364272, Mr. Arivarasan- 7550352490, Mr. Natarasan-9445366044.This temple is on Tiruporur Mambakkam road.Tiruporur is 6 km from here.

It is about 8 km on the road from Thiruporur to Thirukkalukkunram.Sri Tripura Sundari Sametha Sri Aayyaar Wodeyar Temple is located in the remote village of Amur.This ancient temple was built entirely of stones.Moolavar Thirumeni is made of white stone.Other shrines are of Ganesha, Murugan, Brahma, Surya, Bhairava, and Jeshta Devi.Puja takes place for a while.The temple is currently under renovation.Contact Mr. Radha Krishnan- 9840228023, Mr. Jayaraman-9841833452, Mr. Pandian-9444364903.Buses ply here from Tiruporur, and Tambaram.The temple is near Thirukkulam.A head tree. Sri Vaikunda Perumal has a temple in Amur village as Sridevi Bhudevi Samethar.Sri Garudazhwar shrine is in separate hall opposite to Perumal shrine.The temple is in a state of repair.No daily pujas are performed here.Contact Mr. Radhakrishnan-9840228023, Mr. Jayaraman-98418 33452 Mr.Pandian-9444364903.

The ancient Shiva Temple and Perumal Temple are located in Akaram village on Tiruporur Tirukkalukkunram road.The Shivalayam, which is a stone temple, is founded by Sri Kailasanathar.Ambal Thirunamam Sri Akhilandeshwari.Along with Pancha Goshta shrines there are shrines of Vinayaka, Subramaniyar, Bhairava, Nalvar etc.Sometimes a pooja takes place.The temple also has a Thirukkulam.Contact Mr. Ayyappan- 9940872125, Mr. Shanmugam-9677695375. The Perumal here is Sri Vaikundavasa Perumal.There are no pujas here.The temple is in need of repair.

The very old temple is now newly constructed.Sri Lakshminarayana Perumal is depicted in a kolam sitting with mother Sri Lakshmi Devi on her lap.There is a separate temple for Sri Anjaneya nearby.Sometimes a pooja takes place.Contact Mr. Perumal-6380548907, Mr. Paranthaman-638399912, Mr. Shanmugasundaram-99527 84431 Tiruporur - Arungunram about 13 km.Bus facility Koyambedu-Thirukalukkunram, Tiruporur-Thirukalukkunram, Tambaram-Thirukalukkunram.

It is about 7 km from Thirukkalugunram.The Sri Periyandavar temple in the remote village of Thiruvanthi is very famous.Shiva and Goddess Parvati in the form of Sri Periyandavara and Sri Angala Parameshwari are still seen in the very old temple.The 32 Shiva Ganas who came to earth with Lord Shiva have a temple here.Tirupadam, where Lord Shiva was enshrined, is found here.Sri Periyandavar, who is Swayambu, does not have a roof.Shree Angalaparameshwari and Shree Thiruthana Nayaki shrines are nearby.Other shrines are Vinayagar, Murugan, Pattinathar, Vallalar, Tirumool, Vibhuti Vinayagar.The temple pond is nearby with the name Chidhamirtha Pond.The temple head tree is Rudracha tree.Temple timings are 7 AM to 7 PM.Contact Mr. Ekasivan-9842740957, Mr. Raju-8110936920.

Villagers of Periya Vippedu have taken the Shiv Lingam which has been lying unattended in the open for a long time and built a small shed in 2014 to worship it.Kochenga Nayanar Siva Venkatesan, who has been doing the work of constructing sheds for many temples, has also done the work here.Daily puja is held here.Contact Mr. Narayana Murthy-9994141086, Mr. Kubendran-9445373669.This village is 7 km from Thirukkalugunram.The temple also has a shrine.Buses that come here are Chengalpattu-Otteri (75) Thirukhakukunram-Otteri.

It is said that there were once seven temples in the village which was originally called Sivakunram and now known as Sirukunram.In the absence of all of them, only the Sri Valmikeeshwarar Shiva Temple remains.Sage Shri Valmiki worshiped the Lord with this name.Ambal Tirunamam Shri Ketara Gauri.The sage has consecrated seven Shiva Lingams in this temple.Currently only four are found.If you visit Nandi Devar with a smiling face and go inside, Vinayaka and Valli Devasena Sametha Murugan will appear in the Mahamandapam.The temple is located in the Pancha Koshta and has Saneeswarar in the Ambal Koshta.Sometimes a pooja takes place.Contact Mr. Ekambara Shivacharya-9176867741, Mr. Vijaya Pillai-9908806716.Buses come here from Tambaram and Chengalpattu. This temple serves as a place of reparation for childbirth, marriage and Ketara Gauri fast.This Thalathu Eason is blessed mainly for curing cancer. Sri Lakshminaranaya Perumal also has a temple next to the Shiva temple in Sirukunram village.Both the temples were built at the same time.He is seen as Sri Lakshminarayana holding Goddess Sri Lakshmi on his lap.There are sanctuaries of Wodeavar, Tirumangai Alwar, Nammalwar, Vishwaksenaar and Garudalwar.Sometimes a pooja takes place.Contact Mr. Ekambara Shivacharya -9176867741, Mr. Vijayapillai -9908806716.

Head history. Earlier this place was a big forest.Annie lived by hunting animals in the forest.Knowing that this is a sinful act, he came to this profession without any other option.Once when no animal was found, he cut the root of a Vanni tree to satisfy his hunger.The root grew longer and longer.Also look at the pattern of blood on the root.He was horrified and told the king about this.The king came immediately and saw a Shiva Lingam at that place.Even if they tried to take it outside with elephants, it was lingam.did not move.At that time, an order came from Asariri to build a temple on this spot and all the sins of that vedan were removed.It is said that the temple was built here accordingly.
